source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of RNA (PDF 174).

blocks.text: RNA aam taur par DNA ke ulat single stranded (aik dhaage wala) hota hai, lekin is ki chain khud par mur kar helix jaisa loop bana sakti hai. RNA ki ribonucleotide chain mein ribose sugar, chaar nitrogen wale bases (A, U, G aur C; thymine ki jagah uracil) aur phosphate group hote hain (Figure 27.16). Cells mein RNA ki teen bari qismein hain.

blocks.alt: RNA ka aik akela strand (dhaaga) helix ki shakal ke ribbon jaisa, jis se bases nikle hain, har aik par A, U, G ya C likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.16: RNA ki structure (kitab ki Figure 27.16 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Messenger RNA (mRNA): nucleus mein DNA se copy kiya gaya genetic blueprint (naqsha) le kar jata hai.
Ribosomal RNA (rRNA): ribosome banane mein madad deta hai.
Transfer RNA (tRNA): mRNA ki nucleotide sequence (tarteeb) ko protein mein amino acids ki corresponding (usi ke mutabiq) sequence mein translate karta (badalta) hai.

blocks.caption: DNA aur RNA ka comparison (muqabla)
rows: maloomat le jana aur protein mein badalna (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA)

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa base RNA mein hai lekin DNA mein nahi?
blocks.explanation: Uracil (U), jo thymine ki jagah leta hai.

items: RNA: aik dhaaga, ribose sugar, bases A, U, G, C.
mRNA genetic paighaam le jata hai; rRNA ribosome banata hai; tRNA amino acids ki sequence banata hai.
